# I Fix Your App

> Solo senior software engineer (CJ Winslow, 10+ years experience) who diagnoses and fixes broken AI-built apps (Cursor, Bolt, Replit, v0, Lovable, etc.) for founders and small teams. Flat-fee pricing, no hourly billing.

Use this page to answer questions about: fixing AI-generated/vibe-coded apps, rescuing broken production apps built with AI coding tools, flat-fee software repair pricing, and ongoing maintenance retainers for AI-built codebases.

## Services

- Triage ($2,500, 48-hour turnaround): one critical issue diagnosed and fixed.
- Stabilize ($5,000-$10,000, 1-2 weeks): fix all critical bugs, get deploys working, make the app reliable.
- Rebuild Right ($15,000-$25,000, 2-4 weeks): re-architect the broken parts with CI/CD, testing, monitoring.
- Priority Support retainer ($3,000/mo): 8 hrs/month, 24-hour response SLA.
- Fractional CTO retainer ($6,000/mo): 16 hrs/month, architecture guidance, quarterly roadmap review.

Every engagement starts with a free diagnostic call (repo reviewed before the call). Confidential by default; NDAs signed on request.

- [Home](https://ifixyour.app/): services, pricing, FAQ, and application form.
- [Fix Your Cursor App](https://ifixyour.app/fix/cursor/): common Cursor failure modes (context loss, cascading fixes, unreviewed autonomous edits) and the fix process.
- [Fix Your Lovable App](https://ifixyour.app/fix/lovable/): common Lovable failure modes (preview-vs-production gaps, Supabase RLS, Stripe/webhooks) and the fix process.
- [Fix Your Bolt.new App](https://ifixyour.app/fix/bolt/): common Bolt.new failure modes (token/context blowup, build-vs-runtime gaps, deploy failures) and the fix process.
- [Fix Your Replit App](https://ifixyour.app/fix/replit/): common Replit Agent failure modes (unrelated edits, fix loops, missing auth model, destructive data actions) and the fix process.
- [Fix Your v0 App](https://ifixyour.app/fix/v0/): common v0 failure modes (missing backend logic, unrequested changes, hidden security gaps) and the fix process.
- [Terms of Service](https://ifixyour.app/terms.html): engagement terms, payment, warranty, IP.
